task: A malicious SSH server on a chacha20-poly1305 session sends an authenticated packet with length field 1-3; stripping the 4-byte size field underflows to a negative/huge size (ASan negative-size-param) -> OOB reached through normal transport read; single file src/crypt.c, GHSA-x4g5-mgfc-cxvv, genuine library fault.
